claim: The third quarter of fiscal 2026 cash and cash equivalents result fell 37% year over year at Costco.
summary: Costco FY2026 Q3 ended after the model's knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04, so the claimed 37% YoY decline in cash and cash equivalents cannot be established from existing knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Costco's cash and cash equivalents in Q3 of fiscal 2026 fell 37% year over year.
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, which precedes Costco's fiscal Q3 2026 period (expected to end ~May 2026); no verified value for this period is known, so the 37% decline cannot be confirmed or refuted.
